components.text: Whether the preceding theistic considerations provide publicly ascertainable support for the God being inferred.

Whether cellular complexity supplies testable verification of the claimed designer.

Whether shared logic verifies its proposed identification with God's nature.

Whether cellular information and nanotechnology are comparatively unexpected under materialism.
Whether objective mathematics is better grounded in a personal creative mind.
Whether mind-independent logic requires or favors grounding in God's nature.
